BASIS OF PRESENTATION A. Description of Business . Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (“Broadridge” or the “Company”), a Delaware corporation, is a global financial technology leader powering investing, corporate governance, and communications. The Company delivers technology-driven solutions to banks, broker-dealers, asset and wealth managers, public companies, investors, and mutual funds, that enable the Company’s clients to operate, innovate and grow. The Company’s trusted expertise and transformative technology solutions help financial services companies enhance investor engagement, optimize trading and investing, and digitize communications. The principal markets in which the Company operates are located in North America and Europe. The Company operates in two reportable segments: Investor Communication Solutions (“ICS”) and Global Technology and Operations (“GTO”). The Company’s Regulatory Solutions, Data-Driven Fund Solutions, Corporate Issuer Solutions, and Customer Communications Solutions are provided as part of the ICS segment. Through its Regulatory Solutions, the Company provides proxy services for bank, broker-dealer, public company, and fund clients, regulatory communication solutions for asset managers, fund communication solutions for fund managers, and international corporate governance solutions. The Company’s Data-Driven Fund Solutions includes a full range of data-driven analytics solutions for asset managers, broker-dealers, and retirement service providers as well as automated mutual fund and exchange-traded funds trade processing services for financial institutions. Through its Corporate Issuer Solutions, the Company provides an array of services for public companies, including shareholder meeting and proxy services, corporate governance, regulatory filings and disclosure, and stock transfer services. The Company’s Customer Communications Solutions include omni-channel customer communications management solutions for clients across financial services, healthcare, insurance, consumer finance, telecommunications, utilities, and other service industries. The Company provides mission-critical, scale infrastructure to the global financial markets through the GTO segment. In Capital Markets, the Company provides front-to-back multi-asset, multi-currency platforms that power trading and post-trade processing for financial markets globally. In Wealth and Investment Management, the Wealth Platform and capabilities power the full lifecycle from investor experience, to advisor, to optimizing operations, while the Company’s Investment Management solutions provide buy-side technology solutions to the market. The Company’s Distributed Ledger Repo (DLR) technologies led by its DLX solution enables firms to innovate and support new tokenized requirements while its business process outsourcing services enable firms to achieve scale through technology and outsourcing.
